oem.sub: Send your product, packaging and brand requirements; we'll come back with an OEM feasibility check.
oem.briefTitle: Build an enquiry around your brand
oem.briefBody: Discuss your logo and label artwork, packaging format, product sizes, grit grades and intended use. OEM availability, minimum quantities, artwork requirements and timelines are subject to a feasibility review and confirmed quotation.
oem.itemsTitle: A clear brief gets a useful response
oem.itemNote: Include your requirements and reference files in the enquiry.
oem.pr1b: Tell us your application and requirements.
oem.pr2b: Review sizes, grades, backing and packaging.
regions.europe.title: Europe
regions.europe.body: Note size, grit, backing and product files; provide destination port and label language.
regions.na.title: North America
regions.na.body: State inch or metric sizing, attachment type and pack quantities; destination ZIP or port and transport mode.
regions.sa.title: South America
regions.sa.body: Size, mixed-grit quantities and carton label language; destination port and importer documents.
regions.me.title: Middle East
regions.me.body: Material, grit and moisture-safe packaging; destination port and quotation terms.
regions.africa.title: Africa
regions.africa.body: Machine compatibility, required sizes and pack quantities; destination port, carton marks and transport preference.
regions.oceania.title: Oceania
regions.oceania.body: Size, backing, packaging and destination ZIP or port; import and packing requirements.
regions.asia.title: Asia
regions.asia.body: Machine specification, grit range and order mix; delivery city or port and local-language labels.
